# Oman Computing Society (OCS)

Student-led computing and technology community in Oman. Official site: https://ocs-mocha.vercel.app

OCS brings students together through programming, artificial intelligence, research, hackathons, student projects, collaboration, and learning.

## Official profiles

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/oman-computing-society
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/omancomputingsociety
